name: app-bento-colour-block-marathon-tracker-screens
title: Colour-Block Bento Marathon App
whatItIs: Two phone screens for a running-event app on a pale mint backdrop: an event feed and a live timer, both built from interlocking rounded panels in lime, pink, sky blue and mint on a navy shell.
whatItMeans: Bright color-coded panels make every function instantly distinguishable and feel energetic and sporty. The notched, puzzle-like edges make the interface feel playful and tactile.
techniques: Interlocking notched cards that read like puzzle pieces
One saturated pastel per function so color itself works as navigation
Huge tabular numerals for the key metric (pace, timer)
Dark navy container gaps that act as outlines between the color blocks
Small pill buttons with outlines as secondary actions
bestFor: Youthful consumer apps with a playful tone
Data-light screens where one number matters

vocabulary.definition: A grid of differently sized rounded tiles, each holding one idea.
A card whose edge has a tab or cut-out that locks into its neighbour.
An oversized number that is the focal point of a screen.
